```yaml
name: Deploy Call Kent Audio Worker

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: production
      url: https://callkent.com/audio-worker

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to Cloudflare Container Registry
        run: |
          echo "${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}" | docker login registry.cloudflare.com -u ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }} --password-stdin

      - name: Build and push container image
        run: |
          docker buildx build \
            --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 \
            -t registry.cloudflare.com/${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}/call-kent-audio-worker:latest \
            -f workers/audio-worker/Dockerfile \
            --push \
            workers/audio-worker

      - name: Install Wrangler
        run: npm install -g @cloudflare/wrangler

      - name: Deploy worker
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          cd workers/audio-worker
          wrangler publish
```
